title: Alaska Wild Rentals
specs: Equipment suitable for remote Alaska trips beyond road system including rivers, tundra lakes, coastal wilderness, and backcountry hunting areas
Jet boats for shallow rivers, aluminum boats for lakes and coastal water, inflatables and Kaboats for portable adventures
Primary renter and operator must be at least 21 years old with valid government-issued photo ID
Only authorized operators may operate or tow the rental
Renter must be physically and legally capable of safely operating the equipment
Operating rental equipment while impaired by alcohol, cannabis, illegal drugs, or any impairing substance is prohibited
Renter must disclose intended destination before pickup; equipment use limited to approved locations and routes

blurb: Guests rent boats and outdoor gear to explore Alaska's rivers, lakes, coastal waters, and remote wilderness. Equipment includes jet boats, aluminum fishing boats, inflatables, and camping packages. Rentals require planning for weather, water conditions, and safety, with guidance provided by the operator.
extraNote: Full payment generally required to confirm reservation unless otherwise approved · Refundable security deposit may be required depending on boat, equipment, rental length, destination, and reservation · Renter responsible for damage, loss, theft, cleaning, recovery costs, and unauthorized use during rental period · Renter responsible for checking weather, water levels, tides, waves, visibility, hazards, and deciding if conditions are safe · Operating rental equipment while impaired is strictly prohibited
